basic_info.description: This fully renovated 3 bedroom 2 bath home located in the Outer Richmond area is a BEAUTY!! A couple blocks away from Golden Gate Park, Lands End and the famous Cliff House. This gem has a RARE 35' WIDE FRONTAGE giving that grand space feeling on the inside. Leaving nothing undone and an impeccable attention to detail is seen throughout this masterpiece. Maintaining the elegance of its original build and incorporating todays modern look and technology bode well for this house. The Main House boasts, 1460 sq ft of space with 3 big bedrooms and a full bath. The downstairs living space with studies/offices, 816 sq ft of space, is well appointed. Whether entertaining friends, or having a big family...this house will accommodate.  Relax and enjoy the VIEWS of the OCEAN and city from your deck and bedrooms. See for yourself and make this house YOUR NEW HOME!!
